policy.keep: All configurations, logs, evaluation records, reports, unknown source code and small numerical result/reference arrays. Existing full BOS copies remain recovery records.
policy.delete_after_audit: Raw training/replay/chunk arrays, retired model/checkpoint tensors, generated videos/raw frames, bytecode; old orchestration copies only when byte-identical to a pinned Git blob.
policy.protect: All current/held/queued work and inputs, shared environments/models, core repository code, external symlink targets and authentication material. No refresh of active folders.
policy.findings_basis: docs/FINDINGS.md consolidation: DSRL has useful single-seed results; LIBERO/RoboTwin have negative or unadmitted outcomes; no proven memory/ICRL benefit. Preserve the evidence and limits.
policy.review_before_prune: This audit is read-only. Review its classification and results before invoking a separate deletion step.
